title: The Apple MacBook Pro M5 is on Sale, and a Top MacBook to Buy Right Now

claims.claim: Apple refreshed the 14-inch MacBook Pro with the latest M6 chip last month.

evidence.quote: Last month, Apple refreshed the 14-inch MacBook Pro with the latest M6 chip.

claims.claim: The previous-gen M5 model came out in late 2025.

evidence.quote: It's identical to the previous-gen M5 model, which came out in late 2025.

claims.claim: The M5 model is currently available for $200 less on Amazon and Walmart compared to the M6 model.

evidence.quote: Despite having the exact same laptop specs (save for the chip difference), you can currently get the M5 for $200 less on Amazon and Walmart.

claims.claim: The M6 chip comes with two additional CPU and GPU cores.

evidence.quote: The M6 comes with two additional CPU and GPU cores, which is the origin of most of its gains.

claims.claim: The M6 features a second 16-core Neural Engine and faster memory bandwidth.

evidence.quote: The main difference is in AI performance, thanks to the second 16-core Neural Engine and faster memory bandwidth on the M6.

claims.claim: The M6 model includes an upgrade to Wi-Fi 7 wireless connectivity.

evidence.quote: The only other real difference is in wireless connectivity, where you get the bump to Wi-Fi 7 with the M6 model.

claims.claim: The 15-inch MacBook Air model with 16 GB of memory and a terabyte of storage is priced at $1,549, which is $150 off Apple's retail price.

evidence.quote: The model with 16 GB of memory and a terabyte of storage is at its lowest price since June: $1,549. That's $150 off Apple's retail price.
